Sourcing Advantage

From Indian Sources to Global Buyers

India offers a diverse supply base across agricultural, botanical and natural product categories. Avnogen works to connect international buyers with suitable Indian sourcing opportunities while coordinating product requirements, supplier communication, packaging and export processes.

Our current focus spans cow-derived agricultural products and botanical powders, with the product range structured to expand as buyer requirements grow.

Sourcing coordination

We work with Indian suppliers to align product availability with buyer requirements.

Direct buyer communication

Requirements, specifications and quantities are discussed directly with the buyer.

Export process support

We coordinate the documentation and shipment process required for the product and destination.
